name: Beach Ball
summary: Inflated glossy vinyl beach ball with six bright gore panels, white end caps and a small valve plug.
dimensions: 500 mm inflated shell diameter, the task brief’s approximate 20 in class (20 in is 508 mm). This is a generic recreational design with no universal competition standard; advertised uninflated flat sizes are not used.
construction: Editable sphere with exactly six 60-degree coloured gore regions and two disconnected white polar caps. Gore boundary vertices are recessed 1.5 mm to represent shallow vinyl welds; the adjoining faces slope into these channels. A flattened white valve plug sits in the upper cap. Glossy nonmetal vinyl with clear coat; no images or external assets.
accuracy_notes: Inflation is represented as a spherical static shell. Welds taper into the end caps and use a simplified recessed strip instead of layered film. The valve is a small geometric plug without hinge, bore or inflation simulation. Panel colours are generic; slight extent differences follow weld recesses and the plug.
